page.layout: Two parallel columns of a Hebrew grammatical table on one printed page. Left column: entries 1 to 9, ending in "irreg. Kal, 3. f. fæm.". Right column: "conv. R. חוּשׁ." continues the last left entry, then entries 10 to 16. Running head at top of each column. Page number at top right. Catchword "conv." at lower right, signature "P" at lower left.

main_text.l: וַתִּבֶן et ædificavit, apoc. pro וַתִּבְנֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. R. בָּנָה
וַתָּגוּחַ et erupisti, pro וַתָּגוּחַ fut. Kal, 2. f. m. conv. Rad. גּוּחַ
וַתִּגַּל et retexit, apoc. pro וַתִּגַּלֶּה, fut. Piel, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. גָּלָה
וַתָּגָר et peregrinata fuerat, pro וַתָּגוּר, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. R. גּוּר
וַתַּהַר et concepit, apoc. pro וַתַּהֲרֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. Rad. הָרָה
וַתִּזֶן et scortata est, apoc. pro וַתִּזְנֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f fæm. conv. Rad. זָנָה
וַתַּחוּל et doluit, pro וַתָּחוּל fut. Kal, 3 f. fæm. conv. Rad. חוּל.
וַתָּחֹם et pepercit, pro וַתָּחוֹם, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. חוּם.
וַתָּחֵשׁ et festinavit, Job. 31. 5. pro וַתָּחוּשׁ, fut. irreg. Kal, 3. f. fæm.
וַתֵּט et illa inclinavit, apoc. pro וַתֵּטֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. נָטָה.
וַתַּךְ et illa percussit, apoc. pro וַתַּכָּה, fut. Hiph. 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. נָכָה.
וַתַּכֵּה et caligavit, Job. 17.7. apoc. pro וַתִּכְהֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. כָּהָה.
וַתְּכַל et absolvit, apoc. pro וַתְּכַלֶּה, fut. Piel, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. כָּלָה
וַתָּכַל et absolutum fuit, apoc. pro וַתִּכְלֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. כָּלָה.
וַתֵּלָא et defatigaris, Job. 4. 5. apoc. pro וַתִּלְאֶה, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. conv. Rad. לָאָה.
וַתַּלַּה et furebat, Gen. 47. 13. apoc. pro וַתִּלָּהֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are approximated from the scan and may be inexact; several Hebrew forms marked here are uncertain at the print resolution. The page number "113" is read from a small mark at top right and is doubtful. The "P" at lower left is a printed mark beside the catchword and is recorded as the signature.
